stem: A student is trying to classify an unidentified, solid gray material as a metal or a nonmetal. Which question will best help the student classify the material?

options.label: F
options.text: Is the material malleable or ductile?

options.label: G
options.text: Does the material feel hard to the touch?

options.label: H
options.text: Will the material float in water?

options.label: J
options.text: Does the material feel rough or smooth?
